Class MO

java.lang.Object
com.qm.bupt.entity.User
com.qm.bupt.entity.MO
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class MO extends User implements Serializable
Module Organizer (MO) entity, extending the base User class.

Contains MO-specific fields such as staff ID, department, managed modules, and published job IDs. MOs are responsible for posting job openings and reviewing TA applications.
